findings.finding: The bundled academic research packages are noncommercial and cannot be included in a commercial LunaScope distribution without separate permission.
findings.recommendation: Obtain separate commercial permission or exclude these exact packages from a commercial distribution after an owner/legal decision. Do not silently relabel or replace the upstream license.

findings.finding: The repository bundles metadata and local-download workflows for third-party character model assets whose upstream use and redistribution rights have not been verified.
findings.recommendation: Obtain owner/legal confirmation for the intended Stable distribution and catalog workflow, or disable the unresolved catalog entries in a separately reviewed change. Do not bundle model binaries.
